candidateObjectiveEnglish: Ask where the ladder is and why we are stopping at eleven in the printed account.
grammarExplanationEnglish: Use where and why to ask about location and reason. With be, put is/are before the subject: Where is the ladder? With progressive be, keep the -ing verb after the subject: Why are we stopping? Who is there? uses who as the subject, so it has a different pattern.
